picks.reasoning: KC's Caliste has the better individual résumé and their lead conversion is far cleaner than AL's, and they already beat AL 2-0 this July. I don't care that the crowd likes them; I'm picking them because they've earned it on the Rift.

Tempo says KC: +1.4k GD@15 at Worlds and a 2-0 win over AL already this year, even though their Worlds first-dragon rate is only 27%. AL's early game sits at -0.1k over their last 20, so they have to find first tower and first blood to keep up with KC's pace.

Under Fearless, KC's deeper pool (Ryze, Viktor, Syndra mid; Caitlyn and Ezreal bot) gives them more ways to lock a draft advantage than AL's Annie/Yone with Maokai/Qiyana. They also beat AL 2-0 at EWC and sit at 8-2 in their last ten, so I'm backing KC to win the draft and close the game.

KC has the stronger numbers across the board: a 40-15 series record against AL's 34-19, +1.3k GD@15 against AL's -0.1k, and a 2-0 win over AL at EWC 2026 in the most recent meeting. AL's 65% first blood rate and 8/8 lead conversion keep this from being lopsided, but the edge in early-game gold and form favors KC.

KC has the calmer, more settled group right now: they beat AL 2-0 in July and are riding a 9-2 Worlds run with a steady mood that doesn't rattle under pressure. AL plays with real heart, and ALKael's steadiness is a reason to respect them, but their 10-10 form over the last 20 games tells me the belief in their own comebacks hasn't fully settled.
